propositions: AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md incorrectly state that --force is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP for transition and claim operations, contradicting the shipped code.
The 2026-08-18 operator ruling allows --force on all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP) with auditability enforced by the absence of a signed attestation rather than capability withholding.
Documentation must be updated to reflect that forced writes produce no certification and that projects enforce this via CI pipeline checks.
The MCP docstrings in _mcp_writes.py and the scratchy-leprous-galago branch already implement the correct force-everywhere + absent-attestation model.
Out-of-scope CLI-only statements (secret-pattern override, bridge setup, release-notes wizard) must remain unchanged.
